enrichment.headline: Ratifies a student data privacy agreement with Educational Results Partnership for Cal-PASS Plus
enrichment.summary: The district ratifies a data privacy agreement with Educational Results Partnership of Sacramento. It stays in effect as long as the district takes part in Cal-PASS Plus or the group holds any student data. No dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
